tooltip.flight_armor.controls: B only touches the suit you are wearing: deploy it as a cruise carrier when fully worn, recall that suit when all four slots are empty; core formations and inventory suits live in the K core panel. Modifier+B stows or redeploys the whole set, Modifier+Up/Down equips parts, Modifier+R recalls the nearest suit; double-tap Jump toggles hover and Modifier+double-tap Jump performs the high-speed ground slam; V toggles high-speed flight; W/S sets throttle and Sprint adds thrust; R fires a wrist pulse, hold G for the core beam, or a three-lane chest/wing salvo while the wingmen are fully docked; a complete Sentinel uses M to switch overdrive/breach forms, H deploys or recalls its own wingmen while in stable overdrive and otherwise toggles independent-cruise guard; L takes over or hands back the nearest own suit, and the HUD mode bar lists the rerouted key meanings for that mode

screen.flight_armor.client_settings.loca: Local visuals and audio only; server combat rules are unchanged
screen.flight_armor.guide.title: Aether Armor · Visual Control Guide
Store a full suit safely, then establish its unique core link.
It must contain no armor and have no incoming return transaction.
Wear four matching pieces, then Shift + right-click the platform.
An active core auto-binds, or use the held core on a full platform.
Right-click a full platform to inspect ownership, status, and display mode.
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.summon.ti: Context-aware Cruise and Formation with B
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.summon.su: B prioritizes the worn suit; with an active carrier, it can equip a different complete inventory suit.
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.summon.st: Press K and select a suit; the first binding becomes primary.
Set the primary, then choose escort attack, range, and anchor rules.

With a full worn suit, B deploys that suit; if another independent suit is active, the new one becomes an escort. With empty slots and an active carrier, B first equips a different complete inventory suit; otherwise it runs the core formation.
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.summon.ti: The core panel's Run Formation command is always explicit; N cycles available linked suits.
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.flight.su: Hover and high-speed flight are two switchable control states.
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.flight.st: Boots engage hover automatically; double-tap Jump to toggle it.
WASD steers, Jump rises, and Sneak descends.
V toggles speed mode; W accelerates, S brakes, Sprint adds thrust.
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.flight.ti: Braking to zero returns to hover; lights follow actual speed. Press M with a complete Sentinel to toggle overdrive/breach.
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.escort.su: Escorts may engage away from you, hold position, or return home.
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.escort.st: Select a secondary suit in K, then choose Summon as Escort.
Choose targets, range, and whether to follow or hold position.
Select a stable escort/cruising suit and choose Return to Platform.
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.escort.ti: In stable Sentinel overdrive, H controls the worn suit's wing group first; otherwise H toggles independent-cruise guard. Right-click a suit to command, follow, or hold position.
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.weapons.s: Weapons require one complete, stable, claimed, matching suit.
Press R to fire along the crosshair toward the selected target.

Hold G and release to fire. Sentinel overdrive links the chest and both wing cannons only while its wingmen are fully docked; otherwise G fires the chest lane. High-speed charge is allowed, but Ctrl thrust cancels it.
A high-speed landing triggers it; the HUD shows energy, heat, cooldown.
screen.flight_armor.guide.page.weapons.t: Escorts choose rams, wrist fire, core beams, or missiles by variant.
